stage.name: Stage
stage.description: How much the buffer helps (how early a click can be and still be saved). Off = raw input. Stage 1: 1 frame. Stage 2: 2 frames. Stage 3: 4 frames (3 ship / wave). Stage 4: 8 frames (5 ship / wave). Extreme: 20 frames (12 ship / wave). Custom: your own frames, set in the window (Left Alt) with Apply. F6 cycles through them.

window-key-v3.name: Window Key
window-key-v3.description: Shows / hides the Input Buffer window (Log, Stats, Stage).

window-size.name: Window Size
window-size.description: Size of the Input Buffer window.

window-opacity.name: Window Opacity
window-opacity.description: How see-through the Input Buffer window's background is (text stays solid).
